title: Your Life Is Hidden With Christ
story:
A little boy received a precious gift from his grandfather—a small wooden box with a special message inside.

The boy loved the box and kept it safely in a drawer in his room.

One day, a friend asked him why he never carried the box around or showed it to everyone.

The boy smiled and said, "It is special to me. I keep it in a safe place because I don't want it to be lost."

The box was hidden, but it was not forgotten.

In the same way, our life with Christ may not always be visible to everyone around us.

People may not see the prayers we pray, the battles we fight in our hearts, the decisions we make to obey God, or the quiet moments when we trust Him.

Colossians 3:3 reminds us that we have died with Christ and that our life is now hidden with Christ in God.

This means that our deepest identity and security are no longer found in the things of this world.

Our value does not depend on success, possessions, recognition, appearance, or the opinions of other people.

Our true life is connected to Christ.

When we belong to Jesus, the world may see only part of our story, but God knows the whole story.

There may be seasons when you feel unnoticed or wonder whether your faithfulness matters.

Perhaps you serve quietly, pray without anyone knowing, forgive someone who never says thank you, or continue trusting God through a difficult situation.

Remember that your life is hidden with Christ in God.

Your faithfulness is not invisible to Him.

This truth also calls us to live differently.

Because our life belongs to Christ, we should not allow temporary things to control our hearts.

We can let go of the need for approval and choose what pleases God.

We can live with peace because our identity is secure in Christ.

We can face uncertainty without fear because our future is held by God.

Today, remember where your true life is found.

You may not have everything figured out, and others may not understand your journey, but your life is safe with Christ.

Keep seeking Him, keep trusting Him, and keep living for Him.

What is hidden in Christ is secure in God.
life_lesson: Your true identity, security, and future are found in Christ, not in temporary things or other people's opinions. Even when your faithfulness is unseen by others, your life is secure and known by God.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You that my life is hidden with Christ in You.

Help me remember that my true identity does not depend on success, possessions, recognition, appearance, or the opinions of others.

When I feel unnoticed or unimportant, remind me that You see and know every part of my life.

Help me remain faithful even when no one notices my efforts or appreciates what I do.

Teach me to seek Your approval more than the approval of people.

Help me let go of the things that compete for my heart and keep my thoughts focused on Christ.

When I face uncertainty, give me peace because my life and future are secure in Your hands.

Help me live each day in a way that reflects my new life in Christ.

Give me strength to leave behind old attitudes, sinful habits, and worldly desires that do not honor You.

Thank You that my life is safe with Christ and that nothing can separate me from Your love.

Help me trust You completely and live with the confidence that my future is secure in You.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Are you finding your identity in Christ or in success, possessions, recognition, or other people's opinions?

Is there something temporary that has been taking too much control of your heart?

How can you live today in a way that reflects that your true life is hidden with Christ?
verse: For you died, and your life is now hidden with Christ in God.
